_comment: Questions taken VERBATIM from الفريق الدمشقي's production inbox — never invented.
Inventing them is the weakness this whole effort exists to avoid: the headline
35.4%→7% that steered the plan for weeks came from a fixture, not from production.
`class` is the defect class from the plan's §1 table, so results are read per class
— a total flag rate mixes classes with different base rates and misled us once already.
Controls are REQUIRED: a battery that only measures silence rewards a mute bot.
TO GROW THIS TO THE PLAN'S ~50: re-mine prod (412 of his messages matched these
classes) and append here. It is data, so the corpus grows without touching code.
